segments.he: פַּעַם אַחַת לֹא נִכְנְסוּ לַנָּמָל וְכוּ׳.
segments.en: It was taught in the mishna: On «one occasion, they did not enter the port» until after nightfall on Shabbat eve, and they asked Rabban Gamliel whether they were permitted to alight from the boat. He told them that they were permitted to alight, for he had been watching, and he knew that they had entered within the city’s limit before nightfall, and therefore they may walk throughout the city.

moves.summary: The gemara quotes the mishna about Rabban Gamliel's ship entering the port
